The build passes now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. **`src/core/options.js:6`** — the bumped bundler renamed the options field `retries` → `retryCount`, so `options.retries.toFixed(0)` threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. That was the hard failure. Now reads `retryCount` and falls back to `retries` for older callers.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js:7`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so the strict boolean check threw. Unset now resolves to `false`, matching the old loader's default (backoff off unless explicitly enabled).

One thing to confirm: I preserved the old default of **backoff disabled** when the flag is unset. If your new config intends unset to mean enabled, that's a one-line change — but silently flipping retry behavior seemed like the riskier guess.

On the rest of the output — the ~8 warnings are genuine noise from the bump and don't block the build, but two are worth queueing separately since they're not things I can fix from the build script alone:
- `W1042` — `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is removed in the next major, and it's also insecure (no IV).
- `W3307` — circular import between `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js`, undefined resolution order.

Neither of those files exists in this tree (only `options.js` and `retryPolicy.js` are real here), so I left them alone.
